class: Profile-first answers bypass the final declaration gate
symptom: A declaration was checked even when a required state answer did not stay on the page.
root_cause: The agreement shortcut answered attestations during profile filling; the signing gate also checked only planner actions rather than current required fields.
why_tests_missed: Existing signed-last and failed-answer tests failed on the base branch, and profile-first declaration routing lacked coverage.
fix: Defer declarations to sign and check current required fields from both the accessibility snapshot and DOM inventory before signing.
prevention: Apply declarations only through one final validation gate using observed field state.
